original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚技术援助团前总干事奥苏尼坎米去世，享年55岁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚翁多州前教育专员、尼日利亚技术援助团前总干事皮乌斯·奥苏尼坎米博士去世，享年55岁。据Starnews援引一名家族消息人士的报道，他于周六在长期患病后去世。翁多州Ile-Oluji/Oke-Igbo选区全体进步大会党候选人罗蒂米·阿金瓦米德在周六的吊唁信息中证实了他的死讯。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚技术援助团前总干事皮乌斯·奥苏尼坎米博士去世，享年55岁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A former Ondo State Commissioner for Education and ex-Director-General of the Nigerian Technical Aid Corps, Dr Pius Osunyikanmi, is dead.

key_facts.fact: 据报他于周六在长期患病后去世
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Osunyikanmi reportedly died on Saturday at the age of 55 after a protracted illness, according to a report by Starnews, which quoted a family source.

key_facts.fact: 翁多州全体进步大会党候选人阿金瓦米德在吊唁信息中证实其死讯
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Confirming his death in a condolence message on Saturday, the All Progressives Congress candidate for the Ile-Oluji/Oke-Igbo Constituency of Ondo State, Rotimi Akinwamide

uncertainties: 死因及具体病情未获披露，仅称长期患病
去世消息目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
